review_kind: Claude AI translation and review (Claude Opus 5.5) on 2026-11-16 against the exact English source of item 955 on the claude-955-fdr-sweep branch: the labels and tooltips of the nine new alpha settings ops_fdr_sweep_targets, ops_fdr_sweep_max_distance, ops_fdr_sweep_min_reads, ops_fdr_sweep_rules, ops_fdr_sweep_quality_quantiles, ops_fdr_sweep_bootstrap, ops_fdr_sweep_seed, ops_fdr_sweep_shuffle_seeds and ops_fdr_sweep_inputs. Claude AI translation and review (Claude Opus 5.5). No human or native-speaker signoff.

records.source: The decoy FDR targets, in %, of the prefix_fdr_sweep phase. For each target, every method gets the configuration with the most genotyped cells at a pooled decoy FDR no higher than the target, so methods are compared at the same error rate; the lowest FDR every method reaches is added as a last target. Needs ops_prefix_decoy_k above 0. Default 0.5, 1, 2, 5. Alpha.
records.translation: Tálbeitu-FDR-markmiðin, í %, í áfanganum prefix_fdr_sweep. Fyrir hvert markmið fær hver aðferð uppsetninguna með flestar arfgerðargreindar frumur við samanlagt tálbeitu-FDR sem er ekki hærra en markmiðið, svo aðferðirnar eru bornar saman við sömu villutíðni; lægsta FDR sem allar aðferðir ná er bætt við sem síðasta markmiði. Krefst ops_prefix_decoy_k yfir 0. Sjálfgefið 0.5, 1, 2, 5. Alfa.

records.source: The largest read distances the prefix_fdr_sweep phase tries: 0 keeps exact matches only, 1 also keeps reads corrected over one mismatch. Default 0, 1. Alpha.
records.translation: Mestu lestrarfjarlægðir sem áfanginn prefix_fdr_sweep reynir: 0 heldur aðeins nákvæmum samsvörunum, 1 heldur einnig lestrum sem eru leiðréttir yfir eitt misræmi. Sjálfgefið 0, 1. Alfa.

records.source: The fewest reads of a cell's top barcode that the prefix_fdr_sweep phase tries. Default 1, 2, 3. Alpha.
records.translation: Minnsti fjöldi lestra efsta strikamerkis frumu sem áfanginn prefix_fdr_sweep reynir. Sjálfgefið 1, 2, 3. Alfa.

records.source: The cell rules the prefix_fdr_sweep phase tries. 'maxcount' calls the barcode with the most matched reads when no other barcode has as many; 'purity50' also needs at least half of the cell's matched reads on it; 'purity100' needs all of them on one barcode. Default maxcount, purity50, purity100. Alpha.
records.translation: Frumureglurnar sem áfanginn prefix_fdr_sweep reynir. 'maxcount' kallar strikamerkið með flesta paraða lestra þegar ekkert annað strikamerki hefur jafnmarga; 'purity50' krefst einnig þess að minnst helmingur paraðra lestra frumunnar sé á því; 'purity100' krefst þess að þeir séu allir á einu strikamerki. Sjálfgefið maxcount, purity50, purity100. Alfa.

records.source: The read-quality cuts the prefix_fdr_sweep phase tries for a method whose reads carry a quality, as quantiles of that method's reads in cells; no cut is always tried too. Default 0.1 to 0.9 in steps of 0.1. Alpha.
records.translation: Lestrargæðamörkin sem áfanginn prefix_fdr_sweep reynir fyrir aðferð þar sem lestrar bera gæði, sem hlutfallsmörk lestra þeirrar aðferðar í frumum; engin mörk eru einnig alltaf reynd. Sjálfgefið 0.1 til 0.9 í skrefum um 0.1. Alfa.

records.source: Site-bootstrap resamples of the prefix_fdr_sweep phase's 95 % intervals: the genotyped share, the decoy FDR and the difference between methods. Default 2000. Alpha.
records.translation: Endurúrtök staðsetningar-bootstrap fyrir 95 % bil áfangans prefix_fdr_sweep: arfgerðargreinda hlutfallið, tálbeitu-FDR og muninn milli aðferða. Sjálfgefið 2000. Alfa.

records.source: Seed of the prefix_fdr_sweep phase's site bootstrap. The same seed gives the same 95 % intervals on the same reads; another seed draws other resampled sites, so the interval ends move slightly while the chosen configurations and counts stay the same. Default 0. Alpha.
records.translation: Fræ staðsetningar-bootstrap áfangans prefix_fdr_sweep. Sama fræ gefur sömu 95 % bil á sömu lestrum; annað fræ dregur aðrar endurúrtaksstaðsetningar, svo endar bilanna hreyfast lítillega en valdar stillingar og talningar haldast óbreyttar. Sjálfgefið 0. Alfa.

records.source: Seeds of the shuffled whitelists the prefix_fdr_sweep phase matches every read against. Each chosen configuration reports its barcode-shuffle call rate (shuffle-called cells per 100 cells), the mean over these seeds, next to its decoy FDR. Default 0, 1, 2. Alpha.
records.translation: Fræ uppstokkuðu hvítu listanna sem áfanginn prefix_fdr_sweep ber hvern lestur saman við. Hver valin uppsetning tilgreinir kallatíðni strikamerkjauppstokkunar sinnar (frumur kallaðar með uppstokkun á hverjar 100 frumur), meðaltal yfir þessi fræ, við hlið tálbeitu-FDR síns. Sjálfgefið 0, 1, 2. Alfa.

records.source: The reads the prefix_fdr_sweep phase scores, as {'methods': {name: read file, glob or path with {site}}, 'cells': table of cells per site, 'sites': [...], 'selection_sites': [...]}. A method's reads need site, cell and read columns, and may have a quality column. With selection_sites the configurations are chosen on those sites and reported on the others. Empty scores this run's spaCR reads (results/ops_prefix/reads_*.parquet) over the cells that have reads. Default empty. Alpha.
records.translation: Lestrarnir sem áfanginn prefix_fdr_sweep metur, sem {'methods': {name: lestrarskrá, glob eða slóð með {site}}, 'cells': tafla yfir frumur á hverja staðsetningu, 'sites': [...], 'selection_sites': [...]}. Lestrar aðferðar þurfa dálkana site, cell og read, og geta haft dálkinn quality. Með selection_sites eru uppsetningarnar valdar á þeim staðsetningum og tilgreindar á hinum. Tómt metur spaCR-lestra þessarar keyrslu (results/ops_prefix/reads_*.parquet) yfir frumurnar sem hafa lestra. Sjálfgefið tómt. Alfa.
